summary: Test-writing run for #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote red-phase tests specifying the vendored-spec contract and the generated-client service surface, plus a committed deltas document comparing docs/color-matching-api-contract.md against the published OpenAPI spec from viamin/color_matching#110. No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container, so swift test could not be executed locally; both files were verified structurally (delimiter balance scan, JSON fixture parsing). CI (macos-latest, .github/workflows/ci.yml) will execute them.
